name: opacity-checkerboard
description: Opacity checkerboards provide a visual pattern background used in color swatches and UI elements to indicate transparency or when no color is selected.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: The patterned surface. It holds the squares and sets no values of its own.

anatomy.name: square
anatomy.description: Single square of the checkerboard pattern. It sets the square size and holds the light and dark tiles the pattern alternates between.

anatomy.name: light-tile
anatomy.description: The lighter of the two alternating tiles; it sets the lighter tile color.

anatomy.name: dark-tile
anatomy.description: The darker of the two alternating tiles; it sets the darker tile color.

anatomyReview.notes: No Figma page; it appears only as the Checkerboard layer inside other components. React Spectrum S2 draws an inline repeating-conic-gradient and SWC gen2 a CSS fragment with tokens opacity-checkerboard-square-{size,dark,light}. container is the explicit root; square carries the size; light-tile and dark-tile are two parts, each carrying one tile color (owner decision A293 b), so no tone option is needed. The square-light value conflict stays with bead 5m92.5.10.
